Clarify will, in a convenient way, help the user to learn, interpret and communicate better either in your native language or a foreign language. All content is from trusted resources and publishers such as Collins, Merriam Webster, KDictionaries, CappelenDamm, Fagbokforlaget, Det norske Samlaget and several more.

How to perform a search

1) Simply type the word in the language you wish to look up, click “Done” or the magnifying glass icon, and the app will display hits in the languages selected by you. 
2) Hot key - perform a search direct from text in your display, mark the word you wish to look up and scroll to the iOS “Share with function”. Then the dictionary definitions will pop up.
